messages:
maria: quick question — we're seeing customers hit 413s on the embeddings route even when dims header is present. thinking it's framing vs bytes quota interaction?
kevin: yup, usually 413 comes from nginx/content-length but our quota layer also rejects large payloads. are the 413s coming from frontend LB or the quota service?
sophia: we traced one: LB -> runtime returned 413 before preflight returned. payload was 100 vectors * 1024 dims each, JSON array. Content-Length was ~820MB.
liam: that explains it. quota is measured in 'embed-units' (we've been treating as dims*rows) but the ingress fastpath checks raw bytes first. runtime and quota disagree on split decisions.
maria: proposal: add an ingress preflight (lightweight) that returns the effective routing decision + reason without counting against quota and before LB hard limits. console can show the preflight hint to users.
kevin: agree, but ops-bot will choke if we introduce another RPC on the hot path. maybe make it async/cached for repeated requests from same tenant for N seconds.
sophia: +1 on caching. also, we should add a header `X-Vec-Estimate` from SDKs so preflight is cheap (rows:dims:size_estimate).
liam: for rollout UX — console should surface both 'estimated unit cost' and "likely failure mode" (bytes vs dims vs quota). e.g., "likely fail: payload bytes > 600MB (LB)"
maria: and telemetry: add tags preflight_hit=true/false, preflight_reason=(bytes|dims|route_cap), fallback_route=(none|smallbatches|sync-fallback). that helps correlate 413s with routing choices.
kevin: +1. also emit preflight_latency bucket so we can alert if preflight adds >20ms p95.
sophia: quick snippet we used for repro: ```json
{
  "inputs": [[0,...,0], ...],
  "meta": {"vec_dims": 1024}
}
``` - SDKs should send meta header instead of full inputs when doing preflight.
liam: policy question: do we let preflight recommend 'split into 10 batches' or 'switch to sparse dims' ? my vote: recommendations only, no automatic client-side split for now.
maria: agreed — recommendations + an SDK helper that can opt-in to auto-split in a later minor release. console toggle for "auto-split (beta)".
kevin: small ops ask: if preflight is opt-in, we need to add an admin flag before we flip default. safer for Dedicated customers.
liam: also need a dashboard card: "preflight success rate" and "top preflight reasons" per tenant. ties into billing (show estimated cost before submit).
sophia: I'll draft telemetry schema: event=embed_preflight, fields=[tenant_id, rows, dims, bytes_est, route_hint, reason, cache_hit, latency_ms].
maria: perfect. + add a boolean field "console_seen" so we can measure adoption of the console hint.
ops-bot: deploybot: noted — feature flag created: eng_platform.preflight.opt_in (owners: @maria, @kevin).
kevin: next action items: sophia to post PR for telemetry schema, liam to mock console UX, maria to write rollout plan (opt-in -> canary -> default), ops-bot to keep flag.
sophia: will do a tiny preflight proto PR today.
liam: mock ready by EOD, i'll drop screenshots in #eng-platform-demos. :thumbsup:
maria: thanks team. this should reduce mysterious 413s and make quota reasoning less opaque to customers. :raised_hands:"
